items.title: MECH-449 endogenous safety-veto producer validation (running-scale calibrated, harm-ON vs harm-OFF control, ground-truth specificity)
items.note: Substrate validation (diagnostic, non_contributory) for the default-OFF MECH-449 endogenous safety producer (E3Config.use_gng_endogenous_safety; chip-20260918-mech449-endogenous-safety-veto-producer). A PASS satisfies EVB-1409/EXP-0796 (MECH-049) release_condition (b) ONLY; resetting that proposal is /governance's call. CALIBRATION PROVENANCE: orchestrator decisions (orchestrate-20260924-0808, .scratch/orch-20260924/QUESTIONS.md) DECIDED Q-MECH449 -> A (per-seed running harm scale, z-score vs EMA, veto at > +2 SD; three specificity checks; per-seed harm_range >= 0.02 precondition) and Q-MECH449-FLOOR -> A (sd floor = 0.02 / 2 = 0.01, derived; an untrained head is NOT flat in candidate space -- dry-run running raw sd ~0.005-0.007 -- so 0.005 would not bind). Numeric operationalisations confirmed by the orchestrator: C2 fire rate <= 0.25; C4 harm-off fire rate <= 0.01 on every control seed; C3 ground-truth (counterfactual one-step env deepcopy per distinct first action) vetoed-minus-non-vetoed hazard proximity > 0 with >= 5 mixed ticks; C1-C3 each on >= ceil(2/3 n_ok) precondition-met ON seeds; >= 3/5 ON seeds must meet the precondition else substrate_not_ready_requeue. PREMISE CORRECTION: the chip's 'harm pathway already discriminative' held on 1/3 seeds in the 603k regime; this run trains on the 603q ARM_BASE_IA_ONLY regime (V3-EXQ-866b re-run 2026-08-03: 3/3 seeds, harm_eval_range 0.115-0.470), with 5 ON seeds. Step 2.4 GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (endogenous n_safety_nogo_applied) cannot exist in any prior manifest -- the producer did not exist -> run. Step 2.5b re-derive brake: MECH-449 count 1 (937b) < 2. Step 2.5c: SD-PP-B5 (corrupting) overlaps only via ree_core/utils/config.py; its defect is confined to opt-in use_world_interventional, which this driver does not set -- dismissed. Degrading overlaps on agent.py::select_action noted: SD-091, mech005-betagate-decommit-counter, mech290-committed-trajectory-one-way-gate, suffering-derivative-comparator-refractory (603q base enables use_suffering_derivative_comparator, as 603q/866b did), SD-MECH267-CEM-SELECTION-FIX. DV-SYMMETRY: ON arm -- running-scale threshold count + within-tick paired ground-truth difference; not invariant to the manipulation (a uniform per-tick offset can move the count, which is why C2 bounds the rate and C3 is within-tick paired). OFF arm -- same DVs, tests the floor's specificity; would_fire_without_sd_floor recorded. Gate armed only in the 10-episode eval: use_go_nogo_constitution + use_f_eligibility_demotion with the channel-adaptive mean-relative floor. red-team (fable): CONTESTED -- F1 fixed (absolute 0.30 envelope floor all-admitted K=32 -> F-blind eval; now adaptive floor, dry run envelope ~16/32, never all-admit); F2 partly fixed (predicted-state headroom diagnostics recorded; does_not_fire label defers to them) and partly dismissed (precondition is over real states, veto excursion over predicted states that drift more -- not equal by construction); F3 dismissed (pre-registered + orchestrator-confirmed; frac_positive recorded); F4 fixed (unscored control / never-armed gate -> substrate_not_ready_requeue). Smoke PASS (dry run, armed branch + counterfactual exercised). Run on cloud (multinomial selection).

items.title: MECH-266/SD-032a: squash-vs-clamp affinity bounding-operator cap sweep with gain-matched control arm (diagnostic)
items.note: Validates mode-governance-engagement ITEM (1) (the affinity bounding operator) ONLY; items (2) commitment-term grading and (3) production default remain OPEN and are untouched. DIAGNOSTIC (excluded from confidence scoring). PROMOTES NOTHING -- MECH-266 / SD-032a pending_retest_after_substrate holds, and the Stage-H nav-competence dependency gating v3_exq_464d/467d is untouched. DESIGN: crosses the affinity bounding OPERATOR with the cap at EVAL time on clones of one trained curriculum agent per seed (cap, mode and sigma all read live at SalienceCoordinator.tick()). THREE bound arms x CAP_SWEEP [0.75,1.0,1.25,1.5,1.75] x 2 rail arms x 3 seeds [42,43,44] = 30 cells/seed: clamp_baseline (w=3.0, the V3-EXQ-934 baseline design), squash (sigma=cap default), and clamp_gain_matched (clamp operator, w'(cap)=3.0*(cap/(cap+1))/min(1,cap)) -- the ATTRIBUTION CONTROL added by USER DECISION 2026-09-19T23:52:40Z OPTION A. Training held at cap 2.0 under the clamp (464e/934 construction). Seeds 42-44 kept deliberately (934's; its seed 44 guard-PASSED with the highest contact rate, 0.3064). LOAD-BEARING DV: occupancy -- the squash arm's ARM_SYMMETRIC gate via experiments/_lib/regime_occupancy_gate.py, GRADED iff >=2 CONSECUTIVE cap values each mixed in (0.1,0.9) on >=2/3 seeds. Bar TRANSCRIBED from the entry's own failure_record target, never re-derived; gate called ONCE per (bound_arm, rail_arm) over ALL (seed,cap) cells with seed AND sweep_value populated -- NOT 934's per-seed call shape, which is what produced its false routing. The continuous margin is RECORDED AS TELEMETRY WITH NO THRESHOLD (user decision): no numeric threshold for the squash-vs-clamp contrast is registered anywhere. WHY THE THIRD ARM: red-team pass 1 (fable) returned BLOCKING, verified against source -- the operator is applied to EVERY affinity_weights signal (salience_coordinator.py:616-636) including the [0,1]-bounded external_task_drive (agent.py:2760-2765, w=3.0), and at sigma=cap the squash returns 0.500x AT the cap, so clamp->squash moved the external_task logit by -0.96..-1.50 while the dacc_pe degeneracy fix under test moved its logit by only -0.034..-0.173 (8x-28x confound). With two arms neither a PASS nor the null was attributable. GFLAG-0370 records this and also that the why_sigma_equals_cap rationale in the substrate entry does not hold as written. RED-TEAM pass 1 (fable): BLOCKING -> resolved by user OPTION A. RED-TEAM pass 2 (fable, licensed re-spawn since the manipulation changed): CONTESTED, 4 findings, ALL reproduced against source and FIXED -- (F1) the (squash NOT graded, gain_matched graded) cell was unrouted and recorded a false 'no_arm_graded' reason with SD-032a weakens, now its own branch -> gain/non_contributory; (F2) the gain match holds only at engagement e=1.0, so 'the control did not grade' could be over-cutting rather than gradedness -- a false-positive path to supports; cells now record REALIZED drive contribution under all three arm definitions and the gradedness attribution is gated on gain_match_valid (residual < the gain cut it reproduces; boundary definitional, not tuned); (F3) 'occupancy static across arms' was attributed to the item-(2) latch unconditionally, now requires et_sat_mean>0 since engagement near zero produces the same reading; (F4) INHERITED FROM V3-EXQ-934 -- the external_task_drive_engages precondition cannot see a dead drive: measured, with the drive signal at EXACTLY 0.0 the margin still reads 0.3287-0.4950, 6.6x-9.9x the 0.05 floor, because it is floored by external_task_bias=1.0; added external_task_drive_signal_nonzero (a zero-test on the drive's own value). F4 is worth governance attention on its own account. PAIRING: cells are RNG- AND ENV-paired across bound arms (per-cell seed derives from (seed,cap,rail_arm) only, driving reset_all_rng and a fresh per-cell env), bound arm nested INNERMOST -- fixes the vacuous 1e-6 non-degeneracy guard (banked 934 cells differing only in rails already differed by 1.7e-3) and the shared-stateful-env order confound. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = per-cap occupancy under salience_affinity_bound_mode='squash'; that mode landed 2026-09-19 and NO recorded manifest has ever set it (934/935/935a are all clamp-only), so the readout is absent from every banked run -> must run, not reanalyzable. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: MECH-266/SD-032a count=7 but RELEASED -- the named upstream substrate (mode-governance-engagement item (1), cingulate.salience_coordinator.affinity_bound_operator) shows IMPLEMENTED 2026-09-19 in ree-v3/CLAUDE.md; and this is a new EXQ number testing a different mechanism (the operator family) as a diagnostic discriminating WHY the ceiling holds, which Step 2.5b exempts independently. STEP 2.5c: no open 'corrupting' substrate_queue entry overlaps this driver's modules (mode-governance-engagement itself is severity=cosmetic). Runs under these open 'degrading' entries, recorded as known limitations: SD-018 and SD-106 (agent.py::compute_resource_proximity_loss, latent/stack.py), sd061-resume-progress-ecology (causal_grid_world.py::CausalGridWorldV2.step), SD-091 (agent.py::REEAgent.select_action), SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING (config.py, causal_grid_world.py, agent.py), SD-ZWORLD-SENSE-PATH-PARITY (agent.py::REEAgent.sense). SMOKE: PASS (rc=0) -- 12 cells (3 arms x 2 caps x 2 rails), denominator ep N/45, 1 verdict line, gain-matched weights exact (1.714286 at cap 0.75, 1.5 at cap 1.0); a guard-passing run exercised the full analysis path and landed on the new F3 branch (et_drive_mean=0.7256, et_sat=0.0 -> static_but_latch_not_implicated, non_contributory), which pre-fix would have recorded SD-032a weakens against a latch that never fired. validate_experiments --strict: 38/38 OK. Successor to V3-EXQ-934; NOT a supersede -- 934 measured the clamp across the same band and that reading stands.
